items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Minor can give you the history of him. Minor was using him.

ctx.x: I see. What did your sons ever play in brass bands much?
Yeah my son and I only played a couple of times. That little one played regular. Minor can give you the history of him. Minor was using him. Yeah I see.
Mmhmm. Well that's so hard for me to remember all the young people.
